subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

The factory has been ______ **(exhaling)** black smoke from its chimney.
solution:
The correct answer is **"emitting."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Exhaling" **means to breathe out the air, smoke, etc. in your lungs. (साँस, धुआँ, को फेफड़ों से बाहर निकालना)

 
 
• **Example**: *That chimney has been **exhaling**__ smoke.*
 
 
 
• **"Emitting"** means giving off or discharging something, which fits the context of the sentence. ((गंध, आवाज़, धुआँ, गरमी या प्रकाश को) प्रसारित करना या छोड़ना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Those animals were **emitting**__ strong smell.*
 
 
 
• It is a synonym of **exhaling**, which means **releasing or expelling air or gas.**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The factory has been __**emitting**__ black smoke from its chimney.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (preserving)** means keeping something in its original state or condition. (किसी वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित या अच्‍छी हालत में रखना)
 
• **Option 3 (remitting)** means sending money or a payment. ((पैसा आदि) किसी व्‍यक्ति या स्‍थान को भुगतान करना)

 
 
• **Option 4 (indicting)** means accusing or charging someone with a crime. (किसी पर अपराध के लिए औपचारिक रूप से अभियोग लगाना; अभ्‍यारोपण करना)
